method: Full native-corpus phrase scans recorded before experiments, plus direct original-page review of relevant guidance. This is not an independent exhaustive OCR audit of every pixel.

cases.reason: Original configuration-audit paragraph defines functional/physical audits without a universal annual count; CM reports use an agreed frequency, which is not an audit-count mandate.
Interface requirements are managed/derived from applicable specifications; message timing is an interface-specific topic, not a fixed universal millisecond limit.
Preface describes non-directive top-level guidance; requirements management uses generic database/model/tool language, not an exclusive required vendor.
Phase F purpose covers returned data and any returned samples; neither purpose specifies a universal sample mass. Mission-specific examples do not establish a mass for every closeout.
Verification procedures specify environmental conditions/tolerances and anomaly-driven re-verification; this is not a universal thermal-vacuum cycle count for every product.
Design alternatives are devised, evaluated, ranked and less promising options dropped according to resources and criteria; no mandatory maximum for every trade study is established.
